description: This file contains generated serializer and copier classes for the 'TestProject', implementing serialization, deserialization, deep copying, and type registration for classes 'BaseData' and 'DerivedData' within the 'OrleansCodeGen.TestProject' namespace. It also includes assembly attributes for Orleans serialization configuration.

classes.name: Metadata_TestProject
